description: This script lists markdown documentation files in a 'docs' directory, extracts metadata such as summaries and 'read when' hints from front matter, and outputs the information. It is used for managing documentation and ensuring relevant docs are read for specific tasks.

methods.name: compactStrings
methods.description: Normalizes and filters an array of values to produce an array of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: walkMarkdownFiles
methods.description: Recursively traverses directories to find all markdown (.md) files, excluding certain directories.

methods.name: extractMetadata
methods.description: Reads a markdown file, extracts front matter metadata including summary and 'read when' hints, and handles errors.
